Reliable, compliant transport solutions for ambient, chilled and frozen goods.
Who We Are
Chillway Express Specials Ltd is a UK-based, transport-only logistics provider specialising in the controlled movement of ambient, chilled, and frozen goods.
Founded in 1997 and based in Tewkesbury, we deliver reliable, time-critical transport solutions across the UK, operating 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Our strategic location enables rapid response and nationwide coverage at short notice.
We focus exclusively on transport. This allows us to maintain high standards in vehicle hygiene, temperature control, load integrity, and driver professionalism, ensuring goods are protected throughout transit.
Our experienced team brings decades of FMCG and supply chain logistics expertise, enabling us to provide cost-effective solutions without compromising on safety, legality, or compliance
